title: 完成 F1 架构评审并关闭实现入口门槛
objective: 逐项完成 F1 架构评审，补齐可由现有决策推导的边界、风险、验收和回退要求，并以可审计证据决定是否关闭 Core 实现入口门槛。
in_scope: Keycloak、Core、Contracts 与 Ops 的责任和数据边界
身份生命周期、Core 模块依赖、事务、权限、账本和并发语义
数据迁移、保留、恢复、健康检查、可观测性、安全和回退要求
Core 最小纵向链路、测试层级、验收命令、风险和待决事项
必要的 Foundation 文档、ADR、路线、组合状态和当前方向更新
out_of_scope: 产品 OpenAPI、JSON Schema、事件、OAuth scope 或 SDK 修改
Core、Contracts 或 Ops 业务与部署实现
Community、Skin 或其他后续项目开发
远程仓库、推送、密钥、生产域名和真实生产值
contract_impact: review-only; any required public contract change must be executed later in a Contracts-primary workstream
acceptance_evidence: The ten F1 architecture review questions have current file evidence and no unresolved contradictions
Durable identity lifecycle and cross-runtime ownership choices are recorded in an accepted ADR
Foundation defines an executable first Core slice, verification layers, rollback boundaries, and operational inputs
Risks and open questions name owners and decision gates without blocking the approved skeleton scope
Workspace and coordination validation pass before the review gate is closed

direction_exception.authorized_by: MC Plan project owner via explicit MCP-F1-FOUNDATION-003 execution request
direction_exception.reason: Close the owner-authorized F1 architecture gate before any Core business implementation begins.

validation_results: Coordination Start validation passed with one active workstream and no lock conflicts
Workspace validation passed for 6 active repositories, 100 Markdown files, and 28 JSON files
Coordination regression tests passed all 14 cases
